metadata.title: Halcyon-AlertsSync
metadata.description: Combined Logic App playbook that handles the full Halcyon alert lifecycle on a single 1-minute cadence. First creates Sentinel incidents from new Halcyon-attributed SecurityAlerts (deduplicated via watchlist on HalcyonAlertId), then syncs open Halcyon incidents with the latest alert state (alert swap, label sync, close-if-reviewed) and recovers orphaned incidents. This playbook replaces the legacy Halcyon-AlertProcessor and Halcyon-IncidentUpdate playbooks, which should be disabled and removed before deploying this one.
prerequisites: 1. The Halcyon data connector must be deployed and ingesting data into Halcyon_Commands_CL.

2. The Halcyon analytics rule (Halcyon - New Alert Detected) must be deployed with createIncident: false and entity mappings configured. The rule must include the leftanti join against the HalcyonProcessedIds watchlist.
3. The legacy Halcyon-AlertProcessor and Halcyon-IncidentUpdate playbooks must be disabled before deploying this playbook (to avoid duplicate work and watchlist contention).
4. The deploying principal must have permission to create role assignments on the Log Analytics workspace.

metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics workspace containing Halcyon_Commands_CL and Microsoft Sentinel.
Alias of the Sentinel watchlist used to track already-processed HalcyonAlertIds.
Frequency unit for the recurrence trigger. Serves both the AlertProcessor and IncidentUpdate halves of the workflow.
How often to run, in units of RecurrenceFrequency. Default 1 minute serves both halves.

properties.description: Tracks HalcyonAlertIds that have been processed by the Halcyon-AlertsSync playbook to prevent duplicate incidents.

body.query:
let LatestStatus = materialize(
    Halcyon_Commands_CL
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by HalcyonAlertId
    | project HalcyonAlertId, HalcyonTriageStatus, HalcyonDisplayStatus
);
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where AlertName has "Halcyon"
| extend CustomDetails = parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(ExtendedProperties))["Custom Details"]))
| extend HalcyonAlertId = tostring(CustomDetails["HalcyonAlertId"][0])
| where isnotempty(HalcyonAlertId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by HalcyonAlertId
| join kind=inner LatestStatus on HalcyonAlertId
| project HalcyonAlertId, SystemAlertId, AlertName, TimeGenerated, Description, AlertSeverity, HalcyonTriageStatus, HalcyonDisplayStatus

let RecentlyActiveAlertIds = materialize(
    Halcyon_Commands_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | summarize by HalcyonAlertId
);
let LatestStatus = materialize(
    Halcyon_Commands_CL
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by HalcyonAlertId
    | project HalcyonAlertId, HalcyonTriageStatus, HalcyonDisplayStatus
);
let HalcyonAlerts = materialize(
    SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where AlertName has "Halcyon"
    | extend CustomDetails = parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(ExtendedProperties))["Custom Details"]))
    | extend HalcyonAlertId = tostring(CustomDetails["HalcyonAlertId"][0])
    | where isnotempty(HalcyonAlertId)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by HalcyonAlertId
    | project HalcyonAlertId, NewestSystemAlertId = SystemAlertId
);
SecurityIncident
| where Labels has_cs "Halcyon"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| extend IsClosed = (Status == "Closed")
| extend CurrentlyLinkedAlertId = tostring(AlertIds[0])
| join kind=inner (
    SecurityAlert
    | where AlertName has "Halcyon"
    | extend CustomDetails = parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(ExtendedProperties))["Custom Details"]))
    | extend HalcyonAlertId = tostring(CustomDetails["HalcyonAlertId"][0])
    | project SystemAlertId, HalcyonAlertId
) on $left.CurrentlyLinkedAlertId == $right.SystemAlertId
| where HalcyonAlertId in (RecentlyActiveAlertIds | project HalcyonAlertId)
| join kind=leftouter HalcyonAlerts on HalcyonAlertId
| join kind=inner LatestStatus on HalcyonAlertId
| project
    IncidentId = IncidentName,
    HalcyonAlertId,
    IsClosed,
    CurrentlyLinkedAlertId,
    NewestSystemAlertId,
    NeedsAlertSwap = iff(IsClosed or isempty(NewestSystemAlertId), false, CurrentlyLinkedAlertId != NewestSystemAlertId),
    HalcyonTriageStatus,
    HalcyonDisplayStatus

runError.message: @{concat('KQL returned ', length(body('Run_Update_KQL')?['value']), ' rows — circuit breaker tripped (limit 500). Investigate for duplicate data before re-enabling.')}

body.classificationComment: Closed by Halcyon: alert reviewed in Halcyon platform.

body.query:
let HalcyonAlerts = materialize(
    SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where AlertName has "Halcyon"
    | extend CustomDetails = parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(ExtendedProperties))["Custom Details"]))
    | extend HalcyonAlertId = tostring(CustomDetails["HalcyonAlertId"][0])
    | where isnotempty(HalcyonAlertId)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by HalcyonAlertId
    | project HalcyonAlertId, NewestSystemAlertId = SystemAlertId
);
SecurityIncident
| where Labels has_cs "Halcyon"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Status != "Closed"
| where array_length(AlertIds) == 0
| extend HalcyonAlertId = extract(@"Halcyon Alert: ([0-9a-f]{64})", 1, Title)
| where isnotempty(HalcyonAlertId)
| join kind=inner HalcyonAlerts on HalcyonAlertId
| project IncidentId = IncidentName, HalcyonAlertId, NewestSystemAlertId

runError.message: @{concat('Orphan KQL returned ', length(body('Run_Orphan_KQL_Query')?['value']), ' rows — circuit breaker tripped (limit 50). Investigate for unexpected orphaned incidents.')}
